name: Vanity Plate
description:
Premium Material:
  • Crafted from high-quality 1mm aluminum, this vanity plate is built for durability and long-lasting performance. 
  • The lightweight yet sturdy construction is resistant to rust, fading, and weather damage, making it suitable for both indoor and outdoor display. 
  • Its smooth finish and rounded edges provide a sleek, premium appearance that stands out wherever it’s placed.

 

Sizes & Dimensions:
  • Designed to fit most standard vehicle plate frames, this vanity plate measures approximately 12.01 x 6.02 in (30.5 x 15.3 cm). 
  • The pre-slotted mounting holes allow for quick and easy installation on cars, trucks, garages, bedrooms, offices, or decorative displays.

 

Printing Technology:
  • Featuring advanced sublimation printing technology, every design is printed with vibrant colors, sharp details, and a premium glossy finish. 
  • The single-sided print offers excellent color retention and weather resistance, helping maintain a fresh and eye-catching appearance over time.

 

Functionality Use:
  • This vanity plate is more than just a car accessory, it’s a stylish decorative piece perfect for personalizing vehicles, walls, garages, man caves, dorm rooms, or offices. 
  • Lightweight and easy to mount, it adds personality and creativity wherever displayed.

 

Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
  • A unique and thoughtful gift idea for family, friends, graduates, car enthusiasts, and collectors. 
  • Perfect for birthdays, graduations, holidays, anniversaries, Father’s Day, Mother’s Day, Christmas, or special celebrations. 
  • Its personalized and artistic design makes it a memorable keepsake for any occasion.

 

Specification:
  • Processing Time: 3-5 working days average after payment and information updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 7 – 15 working days average (US)
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
